sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: New Beginning (Prestige 3) is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello my brother! So how's it hanging? Not bored yet? Alright alright, just messing with you. I already figured you know how this one goes. You really can't fall off the influential guys' list, dude. At the very least, it's gonna plummet my rep. It's not gonna look good for me if my candidate falls off the list on the third task, so don't get too comfortable. So, like I said last time, something big's cooking. And you and I need to keep our fingers on the pulse. Here's a list of what we need to bring this time. Yeah, it's longer this time. Anyway, you're a smart guy, you'll figure it out."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must be level 35 to start this quest.
- Must have Prestige level 2

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Eliminate 15 PMC operatives
- Eliminate 20 Raiders
- Survive and extract from The Lab
- Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over 3 found in raid PMC figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Scav figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Boss figurines
- Hand over 3 found in raid Trader figurines

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +11,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.1
- 2,000,000 Roubles
  - 2,100,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,300,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Physical Bitcoin
"Excellent. Never letting me down, brother. My credibility is still there, and yours is on the rise. Perfect outcome, isn't it?"
